title: Perigale
extract:
Perigale is  Voruna's signature sniper rifle that uniquely fires four-round bursts. Its high burst power is kept in check by slow reload speed and rather low magazine size for its burst-fire nature, but is able to gain infinite ammo from consecutive headshot hits or kills with headshots. In Voruna's hands, the sniper holds more Ammo Maximum.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
When not zooming in, shots fired will spread out horizontally with pinpoint accuracy.
Two zoom modes:
First zoom has 2x zoom distance and +20% critical damage multiplier, additive to  Vital Sense.
Second zoom has 4x zoom distance and +40% critical damage multiplier, additive to  Vital Sense.
Landing 4 headshots in a burst or a headshot kill grants the "Gale Force" buff, increasing Ammo Efficiency by 100%. The buff lasts 4 seconds and can be refreshed on subsequent chained headshots.

Acquisition
Perigale's blueprint and components can be obtained from Conjunction Survival Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua, whose access requires completion of The War Within; the blueprint comes from Rotation A, while the Barrel, Receiver, and Stock come from Rotation B.
Alternatively they can be purchased from Archimedean Yonta on the Chrysalith, Zariman Ten Zero (requires completion of Angels of the Zariman to access) with  Lua Thrax Plasm, awarded from Conjunction Survival in quantities of 3 (Yuvarium), 5 (Circulus or Yuvarium Steel Path), or 6 (Circulus Steel Path) per rotation or dropped by Hollow Thrax Centurion and Hollow Thrax Legatus that appears at the end of every Conjunction Survival rotation at a 30% drop rate; each component requires 50, while the blueprint requires 100, totaling to 250 Lua Thrax Plasm.
All components can be traded between players, but not the blueprint.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.

Notes
When wielded by  Voruna ( Prime), Perigale gains an additional 24 Ammo Maximum, for a total of 48 (56 for Prime variant).
Multishot,  Xata's Whisper, and Punch Through hitting multiple heads all count as separate headshot hits for triggering the Gale Force buff.
When not zooming in, shots fired will spread out horizontally with pinpoint accuracy, allowing it to potentially hit several heads at once in a line, powering up the ammo efficiency buff.
 Charged Chamber and  Primed Chamber will only apply to the first shot made, but Perigale makes 4 shot bursts, resulting in a state where Gale Force is applied to the weapon in a state that won't benefit from these mods.
By using  Energized Munitions or the Synth Set, one can achieve a magazine missing only one shot, in which case all subsequent shots will benefit from the mods during Gale Force.
Despite requiring the fewest shots to gain combo, the weapon can make it difficult due to the burst fire wasting combo after a kill (for example, 3 shots being missed if the first bullet kills the enemy, resulting in a net negative combo for that kill). Because of this, it’s best to build combo by firing at the bodies of tougher enemies while Gale Force is active
Despite the actual fire rate being much higher than the listed rate,  Internal Bleeding will have double effect while the listed fire rate is below 2.5.

Trivia
Pergalė is a Lithuanian word that translates to "victory".
